### BrilliA to Participate in A.G.P. Virtual Consumer Showcase


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/279274843/files/doc_news/BrilliA-to-Participate-in-A-G-P--Virtual-Consumer-Showcase-2026.pdf)


SINGAPORE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**BrilliA Incorporated (NYSE American: BRIA) ("BrilliA" or the "Company")** , a one-stop service and solution provider for ladies' intimate apparel brands worldwide, today announced that management will participate in the A.G.P. Virtual Consumer Showcase, on November 12, 2026. Kendrew Hartanto, CEO, will participate in a fireside chat at 9:45-10:15 AM ET. All existing and prospective shareholders are invited to join the webcast to learn more about the Company.


**DATE:** November 12, 2026
**TIME:** 9:45-10:15 AM ET
**LINK:**[https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_Ynfr4Ge4Q26Um_dg8csS4w#/registration](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fus02web.zoom.us%2Fwebinar%2Fregister%2FWN_Ynfr4Ge4Q26Um_dg8csS4w%23%2Fregistration&esheet=54635900&newsitemid=20261105592154&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fus02web.zoom.us%2Fwebinar%2Fregister%2FWN_Ynfr4Ge4Q26Um_dg8csS4w%23%2Fregistration&index=1&md5=1f9ad9bfdbf4a1f0c8f2e9a388e7dc78)


The live webcast will be available following registration using the dedicated link above and in the Events & Presentations section of the BrilliA website at[https://brilliaincorporated.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrilliaincorporated.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54635900&newsitemid=20261105592154&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fbrilliaincorporated.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&index=2&md5=12b0acae88f7e0dff813db475039ae5b) .


If you would like to schedule a one-on-one meeting with management, please contact BrilliA’s IR team atbria@fnkir.com .


**About BrilliA**


BrilliA is a comprehensive one-stop service and solution provider for over 30 ladies’ intimate apparel brands worldwide, managing sourcing, design, prototyping, supply chain, logistics, and quality control. The Company works with major international companies, including Fruit of the Loom, HanesBrands Inc., Jockey and H&M.
